title: Best ComfyUI Alternatives for Creative Teams (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: Krea
tools.tagline: · hosted generation canvas with node apps and a documented REST API
tools.modelSupport: Krea’s hosted image and video models

tools.name: Freepik Spaces
tools.tagline: · UI-only canvas bundled with a large licensed stock library
tools.claudeConnection: No first-party MCP server documented for Spaces
tools.modelSupport: Freepik’s hosted image, video and audio models
tools.note: Freepik’s own Spaces docs state a free user can create up to 3 Spaces. Checked 2026-09-01: the developer API docs at docs.freepik.com now redirect to docs.magnific.com, Freepik’s API brand.

tools.name: Figma Weave
tools.tagline: · AI canvas now sold inside the Figma design suite
tools.claudeConnection: No first-party MCP server documented for Weave
tools.modelSupport: Third-party models inside the Weave canvas
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: weavy.ai redirects to weave.figma.com and the site states "Weavy is now Figma Weave." No public Weave API or developer docs are published; the trial is marked "eligible plans only".

tools.name: Flair.ai
tools.tagline: · ecommerce product photoshoot canvas with category templates
tools.note: Re-checked 2026-09-01: flair.ai's homepage lists a "Flair API" as a key feature ("Access via API for integration") and links /pricing from its own nav, but /pricing returned a Cloudflare 522 from the origin, so the plan table could not be read. The homepage CTA reads "Get Started - It's Free", which is a trial prompt rather than a stated free plan, so freeTier stays unverified. No developer docs URL could be confirmed.

tools.name: Scenario
tools.tagline: · game-asset platform with API-driven custom model training
tools.modelSupport: Your own trained Scenario models plus hosted base models
tools.note: Scenario’s docs describe the API as "programmatic access to everything you can do within the Scenario web application"; API credit usage is documented separately at help.scenario.com.
